mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We are starting the morning with clear skies and 53 degrees near Verona Area High School under a full moon.

The City Plan Commission will meet on Wednesday, November 4th to review several development proposals, including an 80-lot final plat for Ardent Glen's third addition and a pending Sub-Zero expansion in Liberty Business Park.
For local events today, you can enjoy live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard or Lake Lou-ee. Tomorrow features yoga at Insight Wellness, and Main Street Trick or Treat is coming up on October 29th.
In police news, officers arrested a school bus driver on Thursday, October 15th for an O W I near Whalen Road and Fairview Terrace, with alcohol ruled out and no reported injuries.
Culver's opens today at 10:00 AM, with Snickers Swirl featured as today's flavor of the day.
